hypothesis: Neighboring Z supports fragment identity and may disambiguate single-slice continuations.
scope: 15 existing real CT XY slices, independent extraction, no in-plane joins, no mesh or final stacked raster

extraction.branch_rule: Remove degree>=3 skeleton nodes; no closing or gap filling; split into remaining paths

registration.objective: NCC of sigma-1 image at fixed ROI interior

controls.anchor: middle CSV point of each original fragment
controls.success: >=3 of 5 controls attached uniquely within 2 px and tracked across >=7 observed slices

status: Prospective parameters for an exploratory pilot; not an independently reviewed preregistration
failure_rule: Preserve failures; if controls fail, diagnose gates/extraction before claiming any success.
